name: The Sound Wave
description: Located steps from Gulf Shores Beach in the new Embassy Suites Resort, Sound Wave combines daily live music, Gulf views, and an energetic atmosphere. This open-air, second-floor venue is the ultimate destination for concerts and live performances in Gulf Shores, featuring a state-of-the-art sound system and an extensive food and drink menu. Whether you're here for the music, the Gulf views, or the lively vibe, The Sound Wave is where the coast comes to life. Daily Live music Monday - Sunday.
address_line_1: 112 W Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA
